adp.meaning_of_absence: No qualifying satellite detection. Does NOT mean there is no haze or smoke.

spark.scene: True-color satellite view of the main Hawaiian Islands from Kauai and Niihau in the northwest to the Big Island in the southeast. Dark blue open ocean dominates the central area with scattered to locally extensive white cumulus and cirrus clouds, with larger cloud bands in the northeast and southwest and orographic clouds banked against islands. No distinct gray or brown haze streak distinguishable from ordinary white clouds is visible.

classify.caveats: No plume found; nothing to classify.

kilauea.activity_summary: The Halema'uma'u eruption of Kīlauea is currently paused after episode 56 fountaining ended on November 5. The summit is reinflating and the next episode of lava fountaining is likely more than a week away. Overview: The Halema'uma'u eruption of Kīlauea is currently paused after episode 56 fountaining ended on November 5.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts were within typical levels in October, and minor inflation continues. Mauna Loa had a slight increase in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 66 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the October reporting period, after 53 in September. These variations are within the typical range for the past two years.
